description.value: Espresso Dolce is a specialty coffee equipment retailer with over 24 years in western Canada, carrying a wide range of residential and commercial espresso machines, burr grinders, and coffee supplies from brands such as La Marzocco, Jura, and Mazzer. The physical store at 1751 Boundary Road offers in-store demos and a service centre for machine repairs. Cyclists interested in home espresso gear could book a store visit or demo, but no beverages or food are served on-site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at espressodolce.ca is clearly a coffee equipment retailer selling espresso machines, grinders, and coffee supplies (both residential and commercial), with a service centre and in-store demos — it is NOT a café or beverage outlet. The phone number 604-326-3333 is confirmed by the website header. No food, drink, bike infrastructure, washrooms, or cyclist amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content. The OSM tag shop=coffee has been mapped to the 'Food & Drink' category in error; this business belongs in a retail category.
concerns: Category mismatch: this is a coffee equipment retail store, not a café or food/drink outlet. OSM shop=coffee has been interpreted as Food & Drink but should be a retail/shopping category.

No food or beverage service confirmed — cyclists will not be able to purchase drinks or food here. All WWC required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are unverifiable and unlikely to be relevant.
Address (1751 Boundary Road) is confirmed in OSM but not explicitly stated in the retrieved website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible retail business with a confirmed physical storefront and functioning website. No food or drink is served, but the business is legitimate and a cyclist in the area could visit for coffee equipment or service.
